data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-4: At ship time, a scan for existing non-bug tickets with detected_by:* tags is performed and any found are listed for remediation

Run a one-time audit: query all tickets with any detected_by:* tag that are NOT bug-type tickets. Document the results as a ticket comment on the epic a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3.

Audit query:
  .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --format=llm | python3 -c "import json,sys; data=json.load(sys.stdin); found=[t for t in data if t.get('ticket_type')!='bug' and any(tg.startswith('detected_by:') for tg in t.get('tags',[]))]; [print(t['ticket_id'], t['ticket_type'], t['tags']) for t in found]; print(f'Total: {len(found)} non-bug tickets with detected_by:* tags')"

If any found: list each ticket_id + ticket_type + tags in the epic comment. Either (a) remove the detected_by:* tag via ticket untag, or (b) accept as known exception with written rationale in the comment.

If none found: post comment 'Audit clean: no non-bug tickets carry detected_by:* tags as of <date>.'

Create a bash script tests/scripts/test-detected-by-audit.sh that: runs the audit query, exits 0 if the result set is empty or all entries have written rationale documented in their ticket comments, exits 1 with descriptive output otherwise.

## Testing Mode
GREEN — the audit is a one-time operational step with a verifiable outcome. Write the audit script first (structural test that it exists and runs), then execute the scan.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Audit script exists and is executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-detected-by-audit.sh
- Audit passes (no unaddressed non-bug detected_by:* tickets found) — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-detected-by-audit.sh
- Epic a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 has a comment documenting the audit result — Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 | python3 -c "import json,sys; t=json.load(sys.stdin); exit(0 if any('Audit' in c.get('body','') and 'detected_by' in c.get('body','') for c in t.get('comments',[])) else 1)"

## File Impact
- tests/scripts/test-detected-by-audit.sh — Create
data.title: Audit existing tickets for non-bug detected_by:* tags and document remediation
